race.comment: HARRY THE THIEF (2) scored first-up at Goulburn then wasn't suited dropping back in distance but caught the eye late over 1000m at Wyong last time. Lightly raced four-year-old in a much more suitable scenario today. Can bounce back. STEVE'S WAY (8) missed the kick then picked up impressively to be beaten narrowly in a comparable race to this at Albury five weeks ago. Drops 1.5kgs under today's scale so despite the gap between runs she should be very competitive. WONDERFUL MISTAKE (9) savaged the line last start to just miss over 1000m at Canberra. Goes back again from a wide draw but can easily finish right over the top. BENGAL (1) hasn't won for a long while but is back in grade and can improve. LUJAEGO (14) went forward then battled on well for third at Wangaratta last time. Very fit after four runs back so must be considered.
